ADR 0025 still has correctness gaps: provider acceptance is currently only a projection update, so rebuild can turn an accepted delivery back into pending; define a replayable acceptance fact or equivalent rebuild-preservation protocol for legacy and provenance-aware deliveries. Historic reconciliation binds follows to memberships current at the fence without requiring proof that the follow belongs to the final uninterrupted legacy admission; require that temporal proof or mark the candidate unproved. The ADR also creates one reconciliation candidate per independent provenance but suppresses every candidate after the first because an effective grant then exists, contradicting its multi-grant survival guarantee; evaluate sibling candidates atomically or exclude grants from the same reconciliation batch from suppression. Finally, specify deterministic sort keys for revocation-time prepared-intent cancellations and grant-end facts.
